summary: Analyzes a font texture sheet surface to derive glyph cell layout and rewrite the pixel transparency mask. Reads the surface object at this+0x64 (width +0x20, height +0x1C, pitch +0x28, pixel format +0x30, flags +0x18), accesses its 16-bit pixel data via ThunkWithArgReorder, scans for sentinel colors to find the horizontal and vertical cell divisions, stores the three key colors at this+0x28/0x2C/0x30 and the cell counts/pitches at this+0x34..0x40, computes total cell count into this+0x44, builds an 8-byte per-cell lookup table at this+0x6D, then walks every pixel and rewrites the alpha-mask bits (clearing them for key-color pixels and setting the +0x18 surface flag 0x800, OR-ing them otherwise). Finalizes the surface through ArgumentReorderWrapper_3230.

local_names.v36: alpha-mask value (0x8000 when pixel format == 5, else 0)

operations.description: Guard on the pixel-format field at *(this+0x64)+0x30: if it is not 5 the alpha-mask value v36 is 0, otherwise it is 0x8000.
Load the surface object pointer at this+0x64, read its flags field +0x18, and call ThunkWithArgReorder(surface, flags, 0) to obtain the 16-bit pixel data pointer.

Read surface width (+0x20), height (+0x1C) and pitch (+0x28); compute the probe index height + (pitch/2)*(width-2) and store three sentinel 16-bit words from the pixel data into this+0x28, this+0x2C and this+0x30.
Scan the pixel row at cell stride for the first sentinel value equal to this+0x28; record the horizontal cell count at this+0x34 and the horizontal cell pitch at this+0x3C.
Scan down the column at cell stride for the first sentinel value equal to this+0x28; record the vertical cell count at this+0x38 and the vertical cell pitch at this+0x40.
Compute total cell count v17 = vertical pitch * horizontal pitch and store it plus 32 overhead at this+0x44.

If v17 > 0, build the per-cell lookup table at this+0x6D: for each cell, scan the 16-bit pixels at the computed cell offset until the key color (this+0x30) is found and store an 8-byte record (grid column, row, cell offset x, cell offset y).

If surface width * height > 0, walk every 16-bit pixel of the sheet: if the pixel equals any of the three key colors (this+0x30, this+0x28 or this+0x2C), clear the alpha-mask bits with v36 and set the surface flags at +0x18 with the 0x800 pixel-modified flag; otherwise OR the alpha-mask value v36 into the pixel.
Clear the alpha-mask bits (v36) from the stored second key color this+0x2C.
Call ArgumentReorderWrapper_3230(surface object, surface flags at +0x18, 0) to finalize the surface and return its result.

clean_pseudocode: w = surface[0x20]; h = surface[0x1C]; pitch = surface[0x28] >> 1;
this+0x28 = pixels[probe-1]; this+0x2C = pixels[probe-2]; this+0x30 = pixels[probe-3];
scan row for first == this+0x28 -> this+0x34 (count), this+0x3C (pitch);
scan column for first == this+0x28 -> this+0x38 (count), this+0x40 (pitch);
if total > 0: build 8-byte per-cell table at this+0x6D (keyed on this+0x30);
if pixel == this+0x30 or pixel == this+0x28 or pixel == this+0x2C: pixel &= ~mask; surface[0x18] |= 0x800
